purpose: VoteLab local-only artwork, generated for this project. WebP assets are delivery encodings of these originals.

prompts.name: hero-vote
prompts.prompt: Create a standalone transparent-background UI illustration asset based on ONLY the ballot-box illustration on the right of the hero banner in the reference. One beautifully crafted compact voting box, warm walnut lower half, matte ivory rounded lid with a slot, a cream voting slip hovering above the slot bearing a raised bronze check mark, and three short bronze motion strokes. Premium restrained miniature sculpture, natural soft shadows, ivory/walnut/antique-gold palette. Isolate ONLY the object; no UI, no text, no surrounding beige panel, no floor, no landscape, no opaque background. Object fully visible with 8% clear padding, centered, high detail. Genuine transparent alpha.

prompts.name: login-vote
prompts.prompt: Create a standalone transparent-background illustration asset matching the sculptural voting arrangement in the LEFT column of the reference. Warm walnut and ivory ballot box, cream ballot with bronze checkmark, small checklist board leaning at front, two understated stacked books to the left, a tiny muted-olive plant behind. Premium matte ceramic, wood and paper, warm soft daylight, sophisticated and restrained. Isolate just the arranged objects with their subtle contact shadows, no UI, no lettering, no surrounding background or rectangular panel. Entire arrangement visible with clear padding. Genuine transparent alpha.

prompts.name: example-entries
prompts.prompt: Beautiful editorial architectural photograph, landscape 3:2. Elegant pale stone university or cultural building with arches framed by leafy trees, soft warm late-afternoon natural sunlight and rich refined shadows. Composition emphasizes artistry and considered framing. Muted natural cream, olive and warm stone colors, no heavy orange filter, no people, no lettering, no logos. This image is an illustrative cover for a general-purpose entry evaluation activity, not a branded campus campaign. Full-bleed professional photography.
